subject.title: feat(ui): declutter the Control UI sidebar with customizable pinned nav and a More section

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this pinned-routes plus More sidebar model and retire existing browser-local navGroupsCollapsed preferences for upgraded Control UI users?
rationale: The code appears coherent, but the PR changes navigation defaults for every Control UI user and replaces a persisted preference shape, which needs maintainer product/upgrade intent rather than an automated cleanup decision.

options.title: Adopt With Explicit Preference Reset
options.body: Merge this direction after maintainer sign-off that old group-collapse preferences can reset under the new pinned/More model.

options.title: Require A Preference Migration
options.body: Map old collapsed groups into a new pinned-route or More-expanded state before merge, with focused upgrade tests.

options.title: Pause For UX Direction
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR if the default pinned routes or More behavior need a different product decision.

recommendation.title: Adopt With Explicit Preference Reset
recommendation.body: Merge this direction after maintainer sign-off that old group-collapse preferences can reset under the new pinned/More model.
